title: First, then, finally
goal: Tell a short story in order with ilki, ondan soň, iň soňunda and şeýle-de bolsa, using -(Y)p, -AndA and the progressive.

intro.text: Order a story with *ilki*, first; *soňra*, then; *ondan soň*, after that; *iň soňunda*, finally. *şeýle-de bolsa* means **however, even so**. Join actions with `-(Y)p`: *Ilki bazara baryp, et aldym. Ondan soň öýe gelip, nahar bişirdim.*

exercises.en: First we had tea. After that we went to town.
exercises.explain: *ondan soň*, after that, comes after *ilki*, first.

exercises.prompt: After that we went to the museum.
exercises.explain: *ondan soň*, after that, then the past with **we**: *gitdik*.

exercises.prompt: Howa sowukdy. Şeýle-de bolsa, biz seýilgähe gitdik.
accept: It was cold. Even so, we went to the park.
It was cold. [However|Still|But], we went to the park.
The weather was cold. [Even so|However|Still|But], we went to the park.

exercises.question: What did Aýna do after the market?

context.tk: Şenbe güni ir turdum. Ilki ýuwunyp, çaý içdim.
context.en: On Saturday I got up early. First I washed and had tea.

context.tk: Soňra bazara baryp, et we gawun aldym.
context.en: Then I went to the market and bought meat and a melon.

context.tk: Ondan soň öýe gelip, palaw bişirdim.
context.en: After that I came home and made palaw.

context.tk: Iň soňunda myhmanlar geldi. Şeýle-de bolsa, palaw entek taýýar däldi!
context.en: In the end the guests came. Even so, the palaw wasn't ready yet!

options: She came home and made palaw.
She met the guests at the market.

why.1: She had tea first, before the market: *Ilki … çaý içdim*.
why.2: The guests came to her home at the end: *Iň soňunda myhmanlar geldi*.

exercises.explain: *Ondan soň öýe gelip, palaw bişirdim*: after that she came home and made palaw.

exercises.prompt: I spent the whole day at home.
exercises.explain: *bütin günümi*, my whole day, as the object of *geçirmek*, to spend.

exercises.prompt: First I washed, then I got dressed.

exercises.en: I was late because the bus didn't come.
exercises.explain: *sebäbi*, because, gives the reason; *şonuň üçin*, so, would give the result.

exercises.prompt: Men ýadawdym, şonuň üçin öýde galdym.
accept: I was tired, so I stayed at home.
I was tired, so I stayed home.
I was tired, that is why I stayed [home|at home].

exercises.label: *durmak*, its own present: I am standing, you are standing…
exercises.explain: *dur* with the endings of `-ýAr`; the *u* of *dur* rounds them: *durun*, *dursuň*.

exercises.prompt: The bus is at the stop.
exercises.explain: *dur*, (it) is standing: Turkmen often names the posture where English just says **is**.

exercises.prompt: Ilki kitap okadym, ondan soň bütin agşam telewizora tomaşa etdim.
accept: First I read a book, then I watched TV all evening.
First I read a book, then I watched television all evening.
First I read a book, then I watched [TV|television] the whole evening.
First I read a book, [after that|and then|and after that] I watched [TV|television] [all evening|the whole evening].
